Marco Jansen to Towhid Hridoy, out Lbw!! What a day this has been, a wicket off the first ball and now a wicket of the last ball of the day. Sensational innings from Hridoy has come to an end! Take a bow. A soft dismissal though, he misses an in-swinging low full-toss as he had shuffled across to the off side. He missed out on the clip shot and was struck low on the pads right in front of the wicket. He did review, but the ball tracking showed he was struck right in front and it was hitting the off stump.
